svg.title: Weld Creators
svg.desc: Weld Creators Trajectory Generation This core module transforms extracted edges into processable welding trajectories. Beyond just creating paths, it calculates the Normal Vectors (torch orientation angles) required for accurate process simulation in both FreeCAD and RoboDK. Weld creation modes: Make Weld: Manual mode. You directly select the specific edges where the weld beads should be placed. Make Weld with All Edges: Automated mode. Instantly generates welds on all the viable edges detected in the previous filtering step. Make Weld with Specific Length: Trims the weld bead by defining offset distances from the start or end (useful for avoiding corners). Make Weld with Chosen Points: High precision mode. Graphically define the exact Start and End points of the trajectory. Make Weld with Multiple Specific Lengths: Segmented mode. Allows you to create stitch or intermittent welds along a single edge. By Bead Quantity: Specify the exact number of weld segments you need, and the system automatically calculates the required gap and length to fit the edge perfectly. By Bead Length: Define the exact length of each weld bead, and let the algorithm determine how many segments fit and the correct pitch between them. By Bead Pitch: Set the specific center-to-center distance between each weld bead to strictly comply with engineering blueprints. Smart Vector Control: Automatically calculates bisector angles between faces and allows manual overrides (angle offsets) or individual normal corrections to avoid robot torch collisions.
